rng: numpy.random.default_rng / PCG64; trial_seed as stored in experiments.py
noise: Independent Gaussian noise per point/component, std = ratio * clean component RMS

preprocessing.noise_estimator: RMS of L2-normalized sixth differences along the time axis; stencil [1,-6,15,-20,15,-6,1]/sqrt(924)
preprocessing.sigma: Maximum estimated component noise standard deviation; one shared window for every component
preprocessing.m_d: Published weak-test half-width along axis d
preprocessing.adaptation: Generalize the degree-6 factor 1500 and cap anisotropic axes separately
preprocessing.scope: Moving-average preprocessing on the original seven PDEs; retain the existing WSINDy test functions, library, scaling and regression
preprocessing.inputs: Observed arrays only; no clean data, injected noise standard deviation, support labels or coefficient truth
